question: What oblation should the wise practitioner perform as a tenth part of the prior practice?
premises: A tenth part of the prior quantity is prescribed.
Lotuses mixed with three sweet substances are the offering material.
The wise practitioner performs the oblation.
inference: The wise practitioner should offer a tenth part as oblations with lotuses mixed with the three sweet substances.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the three sweet substances is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The wise one should offer a tenth part as oblations with lotuses mixed with the three sweet substances.
